title: Tanzanian Whole Roast Chicken
community: Urban Tanzania — the hotel and restaurant celebration chicken
author: Chef Jabir
desc: Kuku Mzima wa Kuoka — a whole chicken marinated in Tanzanian spices, garlic, ginger, and honey, oven-roasted until the skin is magnificently golden and the meat is falling-tender. Tanzania's hotel and restaurant celebration roast.
longDesc: Whole roast chicken with a Tanzanian spice marinade is the celebration dish of urban Tanzania's restaurants and homes — more impressive than jointed pieces, more flavourful from the whole-bird roasting, and visually spectacular when brought to the table.
steps: Score chicken all over. Mix marinade. Rub into scores and under skin.
Roast 40 minutes. Baste with pan juices.
Continue roasting 35—40 minutes, basting every 15 minutes.
chefTips: Basting builds the golden skin layer by layer.
Rest before carving — essential for juicy meat.
Honey in the marinade caramelises into a gorgeous mahogany crust.
cookingScience: See KEN215 for honey roast chicken cooking science.
culturalNote: Whole roast chicken is Tanzania's Sunday family meal elevated — when the whole bird arrives at the table, everyone knows it is a special occasion.
